analysis.rationale: R1 signal re-interpretation found no pipeline that beats R0 gaussian:3 + saturate_weaken_HSV:5 + compression_jpeg:3 on the 5 support pairs by the required margin (>40 dB or +2 dB). Sampling ~30.7 dB across every blur subtype/severity, JPEG severity, order and joint combination indicates a residual component not captured by any single x_distortion pipeline (all content-independent signals except block_boundary already match). The R1 signal-level finding is that jpeg:4 matches target block_boundary better (verify_signals MATCH 5/5) while jpeg:3 is 0.16-0.50 dB closer in PSNR on all pairs; per the deterministic-candidate rule, PSNR governs, so the R0 pipeline is retained and jpeg:4 recorded as a signal-tagged alternative. Note: support_psnr 18.23 is dominated by irrecoverable colour loss (complete S=0 desaturation), so it cannot arbitrate the blur/JPEG severity details; the change rule is applied on simulated 5-pair PSNR as instructed.

signal_reinterpretation.r0_treatment: Analyzer LENS/GLASS suggestion overridden by PSNR; glass only tested once with confounded steps
signal_reinterpretation.r1_finding: Calibrated ranges are gaussian 0.04-0.13, lens 0.08-0.20, glass 0.19-0.41; 1.5398 is ~4x outside the glass range and is inflated by JPEG 8x8 block edges in the Laplacian/gradient ratio. Fair glass:5 test gives verify_signals WEAK (spectral_slope diff 0.200, wiener corr 0.845, block_boundary 19%) and PSNR 28.12. Glass ruled out.
verify_signals for gaussian:3 matches blur:spectral_slope and blur:wiener_kernel; only compression:block_boundary mismatches (37%). Blur type/severity is signal-confirmed.

However jpeg:4 lowers simulated PSNR on every pair: 30.18/26.69/29.08/28.90/30.01 (mean 28.97) vs R0 30.34/27.03/29.35/29.34/30.51 (mean 29.31), delta -0.34 dB. Re-confirmed: verify_signals global:mean_shift and global:variance_ratio MATCH in all four signal checks. Variance algebra still excludes contrast (c>=0.94 needed to keep var_ratio 0.232) and brightness (would add >=25.5 mean shift on top of the V=max desaturation).

signal_reinterpretation.signal: noise_prior sigma 1.98; peeled §B extreme_pct 55.5, spatial_corr 0.945, var_slope 0.0014, vm_slope 0.0877
signal_reinterpretation.r0_treatment: NO_NOISE (structured residual; known extreme_pct FP; noise:2 test degraded PSNR)
signal_reinterpretation.r1_finding: No new evidence for noise. sigma sits on the 2.0 boundary and the residual is highly structured (spatial_corr 0.945) with var_slope~0 (poisson excluded); RGB identity after S=0 makes rgb_ratio/cross_ch uninformative. R0 R11 noise_gaussian_RGB:2 lowered PSNR 30.34->29.93. Also a 4-step option (blind_challenge can sample up to 4 categories) was checked algebraically: pre-blur noise is attenuated below visibility, brightness/contrast are excluded by mean/variance.

five_pair_validation.conclusion: The only R1 candidate that reached a change evaluation on all 5 pairs (signal MATCH) is uniformly slightly worse in PSNR. Best pair0-only new candidate lens:4 (+0.40 dB) has no signal advantage and stays an alternative. No candidate reaches >40 dB or +2 dB, so NO_CHANGE.
